description.en:
This dataset includes main statistical figures for all Finnish municipalities. The municipality boundaries have been added at CSC, they are originally from National Land Survey of Finland.

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

enrichment.descriptive_overview: NIMI (categorical), NAMN (categorical), LANDAREA (numeric), TAAJAMA_ (numeric), POPCHANGE (numeric), N0_14V_ (numeric), N15_64V_ (numeric), N65_V_ (numeric), RUOTSINK_ (numeric), ULKOMAID__ (numeric), MUUTTOVOIT (numeric), PERHEITA (numeric), VALTTULOT (numeric), ASUNTOKUNT (numeric), VUOKRAASUN (numeric), PIENTALO_ (numeric), KES_MOKIT (numeric), KESKTUTKIN (numeric), KORKTUTKIN (numeric), ALKUTUOT_ (numeric), JALOSTUS_ (numeric), PALVELUT_ (numeric), TUNTEMAT_ (numeric), TALOUHUOLT (numeric), ELAKKEELL_ (numeric), KUNTAKOODI (categorical)
